description: This PHP source file is part of the TestLink open-source test management project. It handles uploading and importing test cases and test suites from XML files, including validation, processing custom fields and requirements, and managing test case data integration into the system. The file contains functions for importing test cases and test suites from XML, validating XML structure, and initializing GUI parameters for the web interface.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Represents a test project within TestLink, used for importing keywords and managing test cases.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Manages test cases, validates, creates, updates, and links custom fields and requirements.

classes.name: testsuite
classes.description: Represents a test suite, manages suite creation, updates, and keyword assignment.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Represents a user for authentication and attribution purposes.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: Utility class to handle hierarchical node structure for containers.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Template rendering class for the web interface.

methods.name: importTestCaseDataFromXML
methods.description: Imports test case data from an XML file into TestLink, handling validation and duplication logic.

methods.name: saveImportedTCData
methods.description: Saves a set of imported test case data into TestLink, including custom fields and requirements.

methods.name: importTestCasesFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Processes XML nodes to extract test case data and imports them into the system.

methods.name: getTestCaseSetFromSimpleXMLObj
methods.description: Extracts structured test case data from SimpleXML objects for import.

methods.name: check_xml_tc_tsuite
methods.description: Validates the structure of a test suite XML file.

methods.name: importTestSuitesFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Imports test suites and associated test cases from XML data into the system.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes GUI parameters for file upload and import options based on user session.

methods.name: processTestSuiteCF
methods.description: Processes custom fields associated with test suites during import.
